title: Cadence playbook and launch sentinels for API / Console / Runtime release train
creator: Marissa Chen
description: Establish a compact, repeatable playbook and a set of lightweight "launch sentinels" (automated + human checks) to govern milestone cadence, scope lock, cut criteria, and release-note coordination across API, Console, and Runtime teams for the Q2 release train. The goal is to reduce ambiguity about go/no-go checks, accelerate cross-team signoff, and ensure release notes and GTM assets are ready at each stage.
background: Recent releases had repeated last-minute scope creep and asynchronous release-note updates that delayed marketing and sales enablement. This ticket defines an enforceable cadence and a small set of sentinel checks that intersect engineering, product, design, docs, and support so launch artifacts are available on time.
milestones: M2: Docs & Release Notes Draft Ready - 2025-03-18
M4: Cross-team Launch Dry Run (GTM rehearsal) - 2025-03-24
scope_lock_rules: Only 'safety' or 'regressions' fixes allowed after Feature Freeze; all changes must go through emergency-rollback plan.
Any change after Feature Freeze must have triage ticket, test plan, and explicit PM + ENG lead approval.
Non-blocking UX copy or minor console CSS tweaks should be staged to post-release patch unless requested by Sales with documented customer ask.
cut_criteria: All P0 regressions resolved and verified in canary cluster
End-to-end smoke tests for API surface passing within latency SLOs in canary
Release notes draft reviewed and approved by PM, Docs, and Legal
Console UI flows validated in the QA checklist and QA signoff recorded
Rollout playbook and rollback steps published in the release doc
launch_sentinels: Automated: nightly integration canary that runs representative inference traces and exits on >5% token-latency regression
Automated: release-notes presence check (PR exists + changelog summary) by docs-bot
Human: PM signoff on customer-facing messaging and pricing-related copy
Human: SRE/Runtime lead acceptance for capacity and autoscaling policies for Dedicated customers
Human: Security/compliance reviewer confirms audit log and KMS hooks are preserved for Private deployments
release_notes_plan: Template: Summary, Key user stories, Migration notes, Breaking changes, SLO impacts, Contact for issues
Draft deadline: aligned with M2 milestone
Translation/localization: TBD for EMEA/APAC visibility; decide by M2
Publish channels: release notes page, in-console banner, changelog, repo tag and GitHub release
rollout_strategy: Phase 1: Internal canary (10% of infra) + internal users + teams (Sales demo environment)
Phase 2: Gradual region-by-region ramp with automated metric thresholds for expansion
Phase 3: Full global rollout with monitoring runbooks and on-call rotation for first 72 hours
Fallback: Immediate model-variant switch or capacity throttling if token-latency SLO violated
stakeholders: Engineering leads: Diego Alvarez (API), Linus Park (Runtime), Aisha Mehta (Console)
communications_channels: Weekly cross-functional sync (Mon 10:00 UTC) - meeting notes stored in Drive
Release readiness checklist in Confluence + linked to Linear epics
Automated alerts via PagerDuty for canary/regression breaches

Lock scope with feature owners and log approved exceptions - PM
Prepare GTM deck and sales FAQ - Jonah / Marketing

decisions: Adopt 'launch sentinels' concept: small set of checks that must pass at each milestone; no more than 6 sentinels per milestone.
Require release notes draft by M2 for any feature to be considered in the cut; otherwise feature is deferred.
Canary must include both functional and performance traces; threshold for action is 5% regression for median latency or any P0 failure.
open_questions: Do we require translated release notes for APAC markets on initial launch?
What is the final on-call escalation policy for first 72 hours post-release?
Can Dedicated customers opt out of automatic model-variant fallbacks during rollout?
risks: Late docs or release notes delaying GTM assets
Scope creep after freeze causing additional regressions
Canary false positives causing unnecessary rollback
Regional compliance holds (e.g., data residency) blocking gradual ramp
mitigations: Enforce M2 deadline with automatic blocker if release-notes PR missing
All post-freeze changes require PM + ENG + QA triage and recorded release rationale
Tune canary sensitivity and add human verification step before rollback
Pre-check legal/regulatory requirements as part of M1 signoff for targeted regions
acceptance_criteria: Playbook doc published and shared with all stakeholders
Sentinel automation in place for the canary and release-notes PR check
All M1-M4 milestones have owners and calendar invites
A GTM dry run completed with >80% checklist compliance and documented action items
